subject: Nimbus + Redwood GCP listing: SKU namespace & metering shim review
messages:
From: Nina Patel <partners@nimbus.io>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: gcp-partner@google.com
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SKU namespace conformance for GCP listing - Redwood/Nimbus bundle

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — excited to get Redwood + Nimbus listed as a bundled offering on the GCP Marketplace. We're finalizing the SKU map for GCP and hit a couple of platform gates that we need your help on:

- GCP requires a SKU namespace with per-SKU metering keys and an entitlement ID for co-sell tagging. Our draft (attached) maps Redwood Dedicated, Hosted API, and an optional Private deployment.
- The Marketplace connector expects a 1:1 mapping between SKU and meter ID; Redwood's current SKU conventions use a combined sku:variant pattern (e.g., rwd-std|dedicated). Will that break the connector or do we need a short-lived billing shim?
- Lastly, GCP's publisher review wants an architecture diagram showing how metering events are emitted from the runtime to the billing endpoint. Can you confirm who on your side will own the architecture diagram and a short engineering contact for the shim?

We're aiming to submit to GCP by the end of May — blocked until we resolve the namespace + metering mapping.

Attachment: initial-sku-draft.xlsx (see tab "proposed_map")

Can we lock a 30-minute call tomorrow or Wednesday morning PT?

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Head of Partnerships | Nimbus Integrations
partners@nimbus.io

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <partners@nimbus.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SKU namespace conformance for GCP listing - Redwood/Nimbus bundle

Thanks Nina — this is timely. I'm available tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PT or Wednesday 09:00–12:00 PT. Ben (partner ops) and Karthik (channel/engineering liaison) are cc'd to coordinate.

A few quick clarifying questions so the call is productive:
1) Is the Nimbus bundle intended to support Redwood Dedicated SKUs (reserved capacity)? That affects how we map consumption metrics.
2) Which billing model do you want in the marketplace: usage-based hourly token-metering or a flat subscription SKU? GCP metering semantics differ for both.
3) For the architecture diagram, we can provide a Redwood runtime-to-metering flow, but we need the exact meter IDs you plan to create in GCP so we can wire events. If a shim is required we can propose a minimal lambda/proxy for translation.

I'll prep our SKU guidelines and forward them before the call. If you want to include Nimbus legal on the thread, please add them.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Director, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-11T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SKU namespace conformance for GCP listing - Redwood/Nimbus bundle

Hi Nina + team — following up with the SKU mapping and a quick redline on the bundle packaging. I've attached three files: nimbus-sku-map.xlsx (cleaned mapping with suggested SKU slugs), architecture-diagram.png (runtime -> billing event flow), and docusign-proposal.pdf (commercial terms with co-sell entitlements flagged).

Key redlines / asks from Redwood engineering and partner ops:
- Please change the proposed meter column in tab "proposed_map" to use separate meter IDs per SKU (no combined variant entries). GCP connector will reject compound keys.
- Add a lightweight metering shim (we can supply a sample implementation) that accepts Redwood's internal event shape and emits GCP-compatible meter events. We'll sign off on the shim if it's run in Nimbus infrastructure and the metrics match.
- For co-sell tagging: include the following entitlements in the Marketplace listing metadata: "redwood_co_sell:1", "nimbus_referral:1". We'll need the GCP entitlements to map back to HubSpot for attribution.

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule a 45-minute technical call (include Nimbus eng and GCP partner engineering).
2) Nimbus to populate the meter IDs in the attached spreadsheet and re-upload.
3) Redwood to circulate a short shim reference implementation (example repo + test harness).

Links: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8943

Attachment stubs: nimbus-sku-map.xlsx, architecture-diagram.png, docusign-proposal.pdf
